shortDescription: Shares of new world development HKEX:17 are set to open down 45.5% on Monday after it proposed a $3.2-billion rights issue plan.The plan offers shareholders 11 rights shares for every existing share at HK$0.90 each, representing an 81.5% discount to the last closing price.
